name: Good Luck
overview: Scripture reveals that what some call 'good luck' is ultimately under the sovereign control of God, as seen in Proverbs 16:33 where the casting of lots is directed by the Lord. Ecclesiastes 9:11 acknowledges that chance events occur to all, yet Isaiah 46:9 reminds us that God alone is unchanging and supreme over all circumstances. James 1:17 further clarifies that every good and perfect gift comes from God, who is constant and faithful, contrasting with those who forsake Him as warned in Isaiah 65:11.
